messages:
Alex W.: Hey team — got my MacBook today. Trying to enroll in MDM but hitting 'profile install failed'. Also saw the phish simulation email — will I automatically be part of it? I'm a contractor in EU. Also need KMS dev access for a quick smoke test this week. Who should I ping?
People Ops: Congrats and welcome! :tada: For MDM issues ping Jordan (IT). Phish sims are org-wide by default, but exemptions are possible — tag @Samira. For KMS access fill the access request form (link in onboarding doc).
Jordan (IT): Hi @Alex W. — can you paste the exact error and macOS version? 403/installer issues commonly mean serial not pre-enrolled or network blocking profile download.
Alex W.: macOS 13.5. Error says: 'Profile installation failed: could not verify the signer.' I re-downloaded the profile from the link. Here's what I ran:
```
profiles -I -F ~/Downloads/redwood_mdm.mobileconfig
install: operation failed: code 1 (kMDMProfileInstallFailed)
```
Jordan (IT): Ok. Two quick things: 1) try re-downloading via admin.redwood.com/devices > Enroll while on the company VPN or a home network; 2) run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and paste output. If you still see 403, share the Mac serial (Apple menu > About This Mac) in a DM.
Samira (Security): Alex — you'll be included in the simulation unless you request an exemption for a documented reason (medical leave, active incident response, etc.). If you need exemption, DM me the reason and we can approve it before the cutoff. For KMS: request via the access form and tag me; we grant dev/test keys for onboarding with expiration.
Alex W.: I ran `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and got 'No enrollment found'. When I click enroll on admin.redwood.com I get a 403. Serial is sent in DM.
Jordan (IT): 403 usually means your device's serial isn't in our pre-enroll list. Got the DM, adding your serial now. After I add it try enrolling again and post the console output if it still fails.
People Ops: Quick FYI — onboarding phishing window for new joiners: Tue 2026-03-31 -> Fri 2026-04-02. Notifications will come from phish-sim-bot. If you see the sim, treat it like a real suspicious email and report it via the button. :shield:
phish-sim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation for new hires: 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC -> 2026-04-02 23:59 UTC. Exemption requests must be submitted by 2026-03-29. (automated message)
Alex W.: Dropped serial in DM — thanks. One more question: as a contractor can I use the company VM instead of enrolling my personal laptop? I prefer not to enroll my personal device.
Samira (Security): Contractors are expected to enroll devices when possible. If you can't enroll a personal device, we can provision the hardened guest VM (image: redwood-guest-2026) which is monitored and doesn't get KMS production keys. Request that via the same access form and note contractor status.
Alex W.: Perfect — I'll request the guest VM and the dev KMS keys. Thanks everyone for the quick help :heart:
Jordan (IT): Cool — once your serial is in the roster enrollment should return 200 and the profile will install. Ping here if anything else fails. :white_check_mark:
